A mysterious 2cm object found in Ancient Egypt wall carving

The tiny object has an unusual shape and detailed design, making it easy to wonder whether it was a symbolic artifact, a ceremonial object, or something with a practical purpose. Ancient Egyptian carvings often preserved fascinating details about their beliefs, rituals, daily life, and technology.

Was this simply an artistic symbol, or could it represent something we still don’t fully understand?

Watch closely and decide what you think this mysterious carving depicts.

snippet.description:
How should you actually use AI in UPSC preparation? In this insightful clip, AIR 25 Bhavika Chopra and AIR 49 Tarun Kumar Yadav share two practical perspectives on using AI effectively.

Bhavika emphasizes a critical caution: never outsource your thinking. Use AI to generate questions, but rely on your own mind to build answers, because that’s all you have in the exam hall. On the other hand, Tarun explains how AI can help you learn how to think by breaking down topics, generating multiple dimensions, and giving “fodder points” when you feel stuck.

Together, this creates a balanced approach: AI as a tool for direction and expansion, not a replacement for your thinking. If you’re confused about using AI in UPSC, this will give you absolute clarity.
